column1: # One food per line, columns separated by TABs:
#   id        stable, never reused or renamed: [a-z0-9.-]+
#   category  MEAT FISH DAIRY VEGETABLES GRAIN BREAD DRINKS ALCOHOL DESSERT FASTFOOD OTHER
#   amount    the portion kcal is for, a whole number, or empty
#   unit      g or ml (written back as г/мл in Russian), or empty with no amount
#   kcal      for that portion, a whole number
#   then one name per language, as language=name: en= is required,
#   ru= and sr-Latn= are used when the app is in that language.
# Lines starting with # and empty lines are skipped.
